cards.answer: Ekko is an AP-focused assassin/mage with magic damage, using a dash and empowered blink attack to close in and trigger his passive burst. His ultimate rewinds him to an earlier position, heals him, and damages nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Limit repeated hits, leave his delayed zone, and avoid chasing toward his afterimage.

cards.answer: Z-Drive Resonance: Attacks and damaging abilities stack on the same target; the third stack deals bonus magic damage. Triggering it against a champion grants Ekko movement speed, and the same target cannot be affected again immediately.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before he completes his passive; be cautious about chasing his speed burst.

cards.answer: Timewinder: Ekko throws a grenade that deals magic damage outward, expands into a slowing field, then returns to him and deals magic damage again.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the field and watch the return path toward Ekko.

citations.quote: Active: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that deals magic damage to enemies hit. It expands at max range or upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing nearby enemies. After a delay, the grenade homes back to Ekko, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

facts.claim: Timewinder: Ekko throws a grenade that deals magic damage outward, expands into a slowing field, then returns to him and deals magic damage again.

cards.answer: Parallel Convergence: Ekko creates a delayed zone that slows enemies; entering it grants him a shield and stuns enemies inside. Its passive adds magic damage to his attacks against low-health enemies, increasing with their missing health.
cards.counterplay: Leave the zone before Ekko enters, and avoid lingering in attack range while low on health.

citations.quote: He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

facts.claim: Parallel Convergence: Ekko creates a delayed zone that slows enemies; entering it grants him a shield and stuns enemies inside.

cards.answer: Phase Dive: Ekko dashes, then gains extra range on his next basic attack, which blinks him to its target and deals bonus magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Keep space after his dash; the empowered attack can still close the gap.

cards.answer: Chronobreak: Ekko's afterimage tracks an earlier position. Activating the ability makes him untargetable as he rewinds there, heals him more after greater recent health loss, and causes a magic-damage explosion at his arrival.
cards.counterplay: Watch his afterimage and avoid clustering around his rewind destination.
